notes.subject: feat(approvals): judge only command segments not covered by an Allow rule
notes.summary: Automatic approval now judges only the parts of a compound command that no Allow rule covers, so rule-allowed risky segments no longer force Guardian review, and Guardian receives allowedByRule flags for the remaining parts.
